title: The draft begins at No. 2, and no one knows what the Jets will do

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: The draft begins at No. 2, and no one knows what the Jets will do
sources.description: With the Raiders widely presumed to be taking Indiana quarterback Fernando Mendoza with the first pick (it would be an all-time stunner if they don't), the draft begins at No. 2.
